description: 5 prediction pairs as Heyting-enriched categories (notes/27). Each side built independently from generating influences via meet-transitive closure (free H-category), so the composition axiom holds by construction. The translation functor F is classified strict / lax / broken. Heyting hom values are author-assigned (notes/27 §7); the code verifies the category axioms and computes F's verdict given those assignments.
foundation: Lawvere 1973, Metric spaces / generalized logic / closed categories (TAC Reprints No.1); quantale-enriched categories.

pairs.note: Bailout reach differs: IMF stays ⊤_priv, TARP rises to ⊤_pub → Dev amplifies → expect lax.

pairs.note: Single private backbone outage, identical ranks → expect strict.

pairs.note: National vs global scale: Dev reach broader (⊤_bank) → expect lax.

pairs.note: Hidden denial (⊤_priv) vs overt weaponization (⊤_pub) → Dev amplifies → expect lax.

pairs.note: EA ownership transfer completed (Telenor→Yoma, ⊤_bank-backed local owner), Dev transfer unresolved (⊤_priv) → Dev attenuates → expect broken (functoriality leaks).

honest_limits: Verdicts reflect author-assigned hom matrices, not measured data. What is objective: (1) both sides satisfy the enriched-category axioms, (2) F's strict/lax/broken verdict follows deterministically from the assigned matrices. Replacing assignments with data-derived influence strengths is future work.
